analisis: Suplemento en cápsulas (nutracéutico) con aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, más vitaminas A y E. Se toma 2 cápsulas al día y el frasco trae 60. Es para mujeres que quieren acompañar su proceso de curvas en glúteos y piernas de forma natural. Frasco negro cilíndrico con tapa y base fucsia, etiqueta negra con letras blancas y rosadas.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type.

datos.publico: mujeres que quieren más volumen en glúteos y piernas
datos.adicional: 5 variaciones de su anuncio ganador para escalar con el sistema S.E.P. Misma estructura, colores rosados, frasco Aguaje Complex, íconos de beneficios (glúteos más firmes, piernas con más volumen, fórmula natural) y franja de oferta «Envío gratis · Paga al recibir». Solo cambian la modelo, el lugar, la pose y el titular.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: glossy pink gradient background, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, real aguaje fruits, a framed photo of a woman from behind in fitted clothing, clean thin-line icon modules and a rounded bottom offer bar.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable and natural.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Rounded pill banner and bottom bar in deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside white-outlined circles, soft translucent pink petal and heart shapes in the background, handwritten script accents with small drawn hearts, real aguaje fruits with a halved orange-flesh fruit.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Same as the winning reference: heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / Poppins Black look), all uppercase for the headline, icon labels and bottom bar; the huge accent word in fuchsia with a thick white outline and soft drop shadow; casual handwritten brush script in deep magenta for short emotional accents.
identidad_visual.art_direction: High-contrast pink-and-black look, the product always sharp and identical to the photo, the woman photographed with maximum realism (real skin texture, natural light), natural athletic curves, everything clean and readable on a phone.
